summary: Allocates a five-dword descriptor and a backing array of a2 element slots, then fills every slot with a distinct heap object built by Malloc0x18ByteStructWithInnerBuffer(a6). Returns a pointer to the descriptor. The descriptor stores the element array pointer at index 0, the element count a2 at index 1, the factory parameter a6 at index 2, and the caller-supplied values a4 and a5 at indices 3 and 4. This is an allocation helper shared by three callers, so the descriptor shape is a caller-facing contract.

local_names.a4: caller-supplied value stored at descriptor index 3
